title: Zeus Juice Vermillion Reloaded E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: “The lifeblood of the gods, the colour of the divine.” Such is power of vermilion, it’s a wonder that Zeus Juice have bottled this divine source at all, but bottled it they have in their delicious Vermilion Reloaded shortfill. Rich, juicy Cherries are given a loft from bracing menthol to create a flavoursome and unforgettable e-liquid. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , box mods and sub-ohm tanks .
